note: Real digests for version 0.1.4, built from the plugin repository's main branch at commit c811484b2711 (make release-with-prebuilt-fpp10 VERSION=0.1.4). Cut because 0.1.3 was taken from 39d3f025f7d0, twelve commits earlier, and predates two routes the coordinator on main now calls: the brightness transition gain (plugin #27) and the coordinator-triggered definition republish (plugin #28). Those artifacts are a private candidate build, not a published release, so the default artifact host still serves nothing for this version; the digests are what a bench or a later publication of that same build must match. Regenerate this file from the manifest whenever a new release is cut; there is no tooling that does it automatically. The three native-prebuilt-fpp10 objects were built once each on an Apple Silicon Mac under Docker Desktop for this candidate; unlike 0.1.3, no second host has rebuilt and compared them, so this candidate carries no cross-host reproducibility result.
